ORIGINAL production asset sheet for a colorful post-apocalyptic mobile tower-defense map. Playful casual-game cartoon style, chunky simple shapes, clean dark outlines, saturated colors, soft cel shading, high phone readability, no realism, no text, no logos, no labels.

Create a clean state sheet on warm off-white background for ONE underground bunker secret entrance, consistent across all states and camera angle:
A) CLOSED: circular reinforced hatch embedded in cracked concrete and plants, dim amber indicator.
B) HINT: same hatch, faint pulsing amber seams, tiny dust particles and subtle vine movement cue.
C) OPENING: hatch mechanically lifted/rotated halfway with warm light and steam escaping.
D) OPEN: hatch fully open, short descending stair/tunnel visible with warm yellow-green light.
E) CLEARED/REWARD: open hatch with soft green salvage-energy glow and small scrap crate.

Keep the exact same hatch design and top-down/3/4 game camera in every state. Isolated assets with generous spacing, no roads, no characters, no signs, no words, no UI. Original IP only.
